audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart read Skill/Shen/Shen/Skill/Skill/Shen/Shen. The packet levelChart is Garen for all six pre-item stages with Skill at two-plus items. Six of seven rows disagreed, and every whys[] entry on the page already described Garen winning — whys[0] 'You out-damage Shen's weak early kit in melee at level 1', whys[5] 'Your first item and Perseverance win extended sidelane fights'. The chart was contradicting its own explanations.
audit.why: Shen's lane damage is Q-based and energy-gated, he has no sustain against Perseverance, and Stand United is a map tool rather than a duel answer. Garen holds every lane stage; the matchup only levels out once Shen's tank utility and global R matter more than sidelane dueling. Win rate 52.91% over 3695 games supports a Garen-favoured lane that flattens late.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Skill in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly placed: Garen's 3-5 melee window, Level 6 where Stand United is global rather than local, first-item sustain, and the late evening-out on Shen's utility.

audit.whatIsWrong: The flagged missing interaction is Ki Barrier: 'After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.' Nothing on the page mentioned that every single Shen cast refreshes a shield, which is exactly what eats a Garen burst window. Separately, the energy economy was never stated: Twilight Assault costs 140 energy at rank 1 and Shadow Dash costs 150, so Shen cannot pay for both back to back at low ranks.
audit.why: Garen's damage arrives as a Q auto-reset plus a Judgment spin. A per-cast shield blunts the burst but not the sustained spin, so the correct instruction is to force Ki Barrier out and keep spinning rather than to open with everything. The energy cap is the concrete sequencing cue the packet said was thin: bait the 140-energy Q and the 150-energy taunt is unaffordable for several seconds regardless of its cooldown. The page's existing claim that Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks but not Judgment ticks matches Riot's text ('Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked') and was left intact.
audit.corrected: Ki Barrier named and folded into the tldr, focus, all-in window, mistakes and first-item spike; Shadow Dash re-keyed to its energy cost as well as its 18s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: All-in advice keyed only to Shadow Dash's cooldown, ignoring the energy gate that is often the real limiter.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10 and 150 energy. At rank 1 both the cooldown and the energy bar have to be respected, and the energy bar is visible to the player.
audit.corrected: Commit window stated as Shadow Dash spent AND Ki Barrier already popped.
